caption: “I think @GiorgiaMeloni is a great Prime Minister. I think she’s doing a fantastic job in Italy... She’s one of the real leaders of the world.” –President Donald J. Trump 🇺🇸🇮🇹
text: It's an honor to have the Prime Minister of Italy with us, Prime Minister Maloney, who's doing a fantastic job. I would say that she has taken Europe by storm. I'm proud of sitting here as Prime Minister of Italy. The goal for me is to make the West great again. I think we can do it together. Together we can build a trust and lust in peace. We support your efforts, Storm. She's become a friend and we really have a great relationship between Italy and ourselves. Thank you.
